newsitem.title: CHILE: Bullish Chilean shares rally on electricals.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Chilean shares rally on electricals.

text.p: A buying spree in the electrical and telecom sectors pushed Chilean stocks up in the first round of trade.

The state Anti-Monopoly Commission's ruling in favor of Enersis late Wednesday continued to underpin demand in the power sector, while confidence on the expected merger between Compania de Telecomunicaciones de Chile and VTR boosted telecoms, brokers said.
Enersis was up two percent to 307 pesos and CTC's A share rose 1.8 percent to 3,780 pesos. Entel was up 0.8 percent to 3,125 pesos.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares was up 1.54 percent to 136.86 points, while the all-share IGPA rose was up 1.01 percent to 5827.49 points.

Brokers reported continued strong demand from foreign institutional investors. With the IPSA already exceeding most brokerages' targets for the whole year, many analysts were reviewing their annual forecasts for the bolsa as a whole and for big-volume stocks, they said.
